summary.tldr: Authorizes $21.6 billion in federal spending for the 2024 to 2025 fiscal year.
what_it_does: Authorizes $21,632,370,126 to be paid out of the Consolidated Revenue Fund.
Provides money to defray certain public service expenses for the year ending 31 March 2025.
Sets the bill to come into force on Royal Assent.
summary.background: The bill was introduced in the House of Commons on 10 December 2024 and received Royal Assent on 17 December 2024.
